record.title: GGEN Ecosystem OCEL current
record.body: CELL1 extended the canonical ggen-ecosystem-ocel-pack with 60 exact-subject/frontier admission gates at ggen-marketplace@de1db7fbd7a2755a38cbf8cf9bdee1422a0c4a93 (draft PR #337). No new deterministic OCEL artifact was generated in this invocation. The canonical OCEL artifact therefore remains the previously admitted artifact sha256:0b059d5edbffabba09dd7f17196d9c8686775ee351acf5e16cc81e5a95f7df51; this run does not claim a new digest or any O/Q/M promotion. Fresh exact heads were observed for all 25 forced repositories. The new gates make exact subject, standing, event traceability, and U-M/G-O arithmetic mechanically falsifiable for subsequent projections.
